OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code on input; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+()0-9 -]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to the current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

        - lastName
        - address
        - city

## Summary

Added a `customerCode` field formatted `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` assigned on owner creation via `POST /api/owners`.

**What the code does:** when an owner is created, `LAST3` = upper-cased first three letters of `lastName`, and `NNNN` = a 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current owner count (`findAll().size() + 1`), evaluated before the new owner is saved — so consecutive creates get consecutive numbers (e.g. `SMI-0007`).

**Files changed:**

1. **`model/Owner.java`** — added `customerCode` field (`@Column(name = "customer_code")`) with getter/setter.

2. **`rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java`** (new) — OfficeFloor step that reads the built `@Val Owner`, computes the code, and mutates it in place.

3. **`officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`** — wired `assignCustomerCode` into the pipeline (after `applyRegistrationDate`, before `save`, under `govern: [ transaction ]`), so the count is read inside the same transaction just before the insert.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added `customerCode` as a `readOnly` property on the `Owner` response schema, which generates the field on `OwnerDto`; MapStruct maps it by name, so `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns it.

5. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added the `customer_code` column to the `owners` table, and fixed the hsqldb `data.sql` positional seed inserts to include the extra column.

**Tests:** `AcceptanceTest.coreFormatAndGlobalSequence` passes, and the full suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
